title: Apply a Firewall Baseline (firewalld or ufw, auto-detected)
description: Opens a list of services/ports across mixed RHEL/Rocky (firewalld) and Debian (ufw) inventory -- one playbook, auto-detected per host via ansible_facts['os_family']. Uses the firewall-cmd/ufw command-line tools directly (not collection-specific modules), so this needs nothing beyond bare ansible-core.

variables.name: ALLOWED_SERVICES
variables.prompt: Service names to allow, space-separated; e.g. 'ssh nfs' (firewalld service names; ufw treats them as service/app names too)

variables.name: ALLOWED_PORTS
variables.prompt: Extra ports to allow, space-separated, each as PORT/PROTO (e.g. '6817/tcp 6818/tcp')
